Roof washing

Are you looking for a local soft washing company that'll remove the accumulation of dirt, grime, and mold from your roof while providing excellent customer service?

Free estimatesResidential & commercialLake Mary & Central FL
Get a free quote Call 407-717-8191

What this is

Roof cleaning in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services provides fast, friendly customer service and expert roof cleanings, using our soft washing technique, making your roof look new again. Our soft washing specialists will provide you with a thorough roof cleaning ensuring your roof is completely cleared of molds, grime, dirt, and more.

The important word is soft. A roof should never see a pressure washer — high pressure lifts granules off asphalt shingles and can drive water up under the courses. Soft washing uses low pressure and a cleaning solution, so the growth goes and the roof is left alone.

What's involved

How it works, and what shapes the quote.

Low pressure, always

Low-pressure water with a mixture of cleaning solutions. The solution does the work.

Mold, mildew, dirt, grime

What affects the scope

  • Roof size and pitch
  • Shingle, tile or metal
  • How heavy the streaking is
  • Overhanging trees
  • Gutters and solar panels on the same roof
  • Plants below the eaves

Questions

Before you call.

Why not just pressure wash the roof?

Because high pressure strips the granules that protect asphalt shingles and can force water under the courses. Soft washing is the correct method and the only one we use on roofs.

What causes the black streaks?

Biological growth — mold, mildew and algae — not road dirt. That is why it comes back after a rinse.

Do you clean gutters at the same time?

Yes. Gutter cleaning is a soft-wash service too and fits on the same visit.
